summary: Describes a way to save bandwidth when exporting flow or packet records with IPFIX. Information shared by many records is sent once and kept separately from the details that differ. Because PSAMP packet reports are built on IPFIX, the same method applies to them.

eli5.summary: If every letter in a pile had the same long address, you could write the address once on a cover sheet. This note does that for network reports, so less data has to be sent.

questions: how to reduce ipfix export bandwidth
